Subject: Marquette Home & Garden - Referral Required

Hi Leon,

Thanks for the Marquette Home & Garden submission. I have everything needed to review this risk.

However, this account requires referral to senior underwriting due to coastal exposure concerns. Specifically, 2 locations fall within 16 km of the coast, and we're managing significant accumulation in this area with our existing portfolio already showing high total insured values within 25 km.

I'll escalate this internally and circle back within 2-3 business days. Given the coastal concentration, you may also want to consider reaching out to a specialty coastal property market in parallel that focuses on these exposures.

I'll be in touch soon.

Best regards,  
[Underwriter name]
